company.name: ConnectSphere
company.description: A global telecommunications provider offering mobile, broadband, and enterprise services across 20 countries.
company.mission: Empowering individuals and businesses with cutting-edge communication technologies.
company.vision: To be the most trusted telecom provider, delivering unparalleled connectivity and customer experience.

support_channels.live_chat: Available on www.connectsphere.com and mobile app

features.security: Family security package (parental controls, device tracking)

smart_home_devices.name: ConnectSphere Smart Hub
smart_home_devices.details: Controls smart lights, thermostats, security cameras

devices.financing: 0% interest for 24 months on devices over $200 with approved credit

refunds.service: Full refund within 14 days if no usage

cancellation_and_termination.prepaid_plans: No fees, service ends at billing cycle

privacy.third_party_sharing: No data sold, shared with consent or for service delivery

general.question: What is ConnectSphere’s coverage like?
general.answer: 5G in 95% of urban areas, 4G LTE in rural areas. Check www.connectsphere.com/coverage.

general.question: How do I activate my service?
general.answer: Activate at www.connectsphere.com/activate, via app, or call 1-800-CONNECT.

general.question: Can I keep my phone number?
general.answer: Yes, provide current carrier details during activation.

billing_and_plans.question: How do I view my bill?
billing_and_plans.answer: Log in at www.connectsphere.com or use the app.

billing_and_plans.question: Can I change my plan mid-cycle?
billing_and_plans.answer: Yes, changes effective next cycle. Contact support for immediate changes (prorated charges).

billing_and_plans.question: What happens if I exceed my data limit?
billing_and_plans.answer: Prepaid: Data stops. Postpaid: Throttled to 2G or purchase additional data.

technical_support.question: Why is my internet slow?
technical_support.answer: Possible causes: congestion, high device count, plan limits. Run speed test and contact support.

technical_support.question: How do I set up my ConnectSphere Smart Hub?
technical_support.answer: Use ConnectSphere app setup wizard to pair with devices.

technical_support.question: What is the warranty on devices?
technical_support.answer: 1-year limited warranty on ConnectSphere devices; extended warranties available.

streaming_and_add_ons.question: How do I access ConnectSphere Stream?
streaming_and_add_ons.answer: Included with ConnectPro/ConnectFamily or standalone at www.connectsphere.com/stream.

streaming_and_add_ons.question: Can I use international roaming?
streaming_and_add_ons.answer: Included in FlexMax/ConnectPro. Add-on packs available for other plans.

support_scripts.greeting: Thank you for contacting ConnectSphere! How can I assist you today?
support_scripts.billing_inquiry: I’d be happy to help with your billing question. Could you specify if you’re asking about your current bill, payment options, or something else?
support_scripts.technical_issue: I’m sorry to hear you’re experiencing an issue. Could you describe the problem? For example, is it related to mobile data, broadband, or a device?
support_scripts.plan_upgrade_downgrade: I can help you explore plan options. Are you looking to upgrade for more data or features, or downgrade to save on costs? Let me pull up the best options for you.
support_scripts.escalation: I understand this issue may need further attention. I’ll escalate your case to our specialized support team. Can you confirm your account number or registered email?

metrics_and_slas.first_response_time: Within 2 minutes for live chat, 24 hours for email

training_guidelines.personalization: Use customer name if provided, reference account details
training_guidelines.proactive_solutions: Suggest troubleshooting or plan upgrades based on needs
training_guidelines.knowledge_updates: Sync with ConnectSphere system for real-time plan changes, outages, promotions

sample_scenarios.customer: My internet is really slow, and I’m on the FiberFast plan.
sample_scenarios.response: I’m sorry to hear your internet is slow. Let’s troubleshoot. First, can you run a speed test at www.connectsphere.com/speedtest and share the results? Also, how many devices are connected to your network?

sample_scenarios.customer: What’s the difference between FlexPlus and FlexMax?
sample_scenarios.response: Great question! FlexPlus ($35/month) offers 15GB of 5G data, unlimited international texting, and 5GB of hotspot data. FlexMax ($50/month) provides unlimited 5G data (35GB high-speed), free roaming in 50+ countries, and 10GB of hotspot data. Would you like me to check which plan best fits your usage?

sample_scenarios.customer: My ConnectSphere Pulse won’t turn on.
sample_scenarios.response: Let’s try a few steps to get your Pulse working. Please charge it for 30 minutes, then hold the power button for 10 seconds to perform a soft reset. If it still doesn’t turn on, I can check your warranty status. Can you provide your account number or the device’s serial number?
